subject: Hosted API payment preferences & invoicing workflow
messages:
From: Morgan Ellis <morgan@pilotretail.com>
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-09-28T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: Quick question on Hosted API billing options

Hi Neha,

Thanks for the demo last week — PilotRetail liked the latency profile and embedding accuracy on our test workload. Before we move to contract talks, Finance asked me to clarify a couple of billing items:

- Do you support monthly invoicing (net terms) for Hosted API usage, or is card-on-file required?
- If you offer invoices, what are the standard net terms (Net 30/45/60)? Any credit checks needed?
- Any minimums or commitments tied to invoiced accounts?

Can you send over the baseline rate card (or link) and a short note on the invoicing flow so I can share with our AP team?

Appreciate it —
Morgan
Morgan Ellis
Head of Platform, PilotRetail Inc
morgan@pilotretail.com
+1 415-555-0198
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Morgan Ellis <morgan@pilotretail.com>
Cc: PilotRetail Finance <ap@pilotretail.com>
Date: 2026-09-29T11:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick question on Hosted API billing options

Hi Morgan — great to hear PilotRetail's team found the demo useful. Short answers up front, followed by details:

- We support both card-on-file (immediate pay) and monthly invoicing.
- Standard investigational terms: Net 30 on invoice; Net 45/60 can be considered for enterprise with underwriting.
- For Net 30 we typically require a Purchase Order (PO) and a quick credit/sales intake with finance. No formal bank guarantee for most mid-market customers.
- Minimums: there is no mandatory platform minimum for hosted API, but discounts and committed pricing are tied to monthly or annual spend commitments.

I've attached our latest rate card (Redwood_ratecard_v2.pdf) — it lists base per-token pricing, embedding units, and commitment bands that unlock volume discounts. A few practical notes:

- If you want invoicing, send a PO to ap@redwood.ai and we'll provision Net 30 invoices after a short onboarding checklist.
- If PilotRetail prefers to start on card and move to invoicing later, we can migrate billing and consolidate usage retroactively to the month the PO is received (subject to billing system timelines).
- For discounts tied to a commit, we require the commit documented in the SOW or order form.

Would you like me to introduce our finance ops lead to yours so we can get PO and tax info?

Attachment: Redwood_ratecard_v2.pdf (PDF, 240KB)

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Enterprise Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.ai | +1 650-555-0133
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-09-30T08:20:00-07:00
Subject: Pricing suggestion: PilotRetail invoicing request

Marissa/Ben — threading you both for quick pricing guidance. PilotRetail (Morgan) needs confirmation on monthly invoice + Net 30. They are evaluating committed discounts but may start card-first and flip to invoicing once PO arrives.

Context: expected first-month usage ~ $25k; they may commit to $100k ARR in year one if the pilot looks good.

My proposal:
- Offer Net 30 invoicing upon receipt of PO + acceptance of SOW.
- Approve a one-time onboarding credit of $5k (to offset pilot costs) and offer a 10% first-year commit discount if they sign a $100k annual commit.
- Require finance to run a standard AP intake (no heavy credit piece).

Questions: do we need to route this through RevOps for approval or is this within our standard delegated discount? Also want to confirm language for retroactive billing when migrating from card to PO.

Thanks — I can hop on a 15m if helpful.
Neha
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-01T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Pricing suggestion: PilotRetail invoicing request

Neha — good summary. Approve the flow with these conditions:

- Net 30 upon PO is OK. Finance will do standard AP checks; no formal credit hold for $100k ARR profile.
- We can offer a 10% first-year commit discount for $100k+ annualized commit. For the pilot (approx $25k), provide a one-time $5k onboarding credit as you proposed.
- Important: include a minimum monthly billing floor during the first 90 days once invoicing starts (e.g., $10k/mo) to protect unit economics if usage drops unexpectedly. This should be in the order form.

Ask Neha to route the draft order form to RevOps (cc: revops@redwood.ai) with the PO trigger clause and the minimums clause. Finance will accept emailed POs to ap@redwood.ai and will confirm tax requirements.

Ben
Ben Carter
Director, Commercial Ops | Redwood Inference
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Morgan Ellis <morgan@pilotretail.com>
Cc: PilotRetail Finance <ap@pilotretail.com>, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-03T15:46:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick question on Hosted API billing options

Hi Morgan — thanks for the quick turnaround. Per internal review, here are the agreed items we can proceed with:

1) Billing cadence: PilotRetail can be set up on monthly invoicing with Net 30 payment terms. To enable Net 30 we will need a PO from PilotRetail sent to ap@redwood.ai.
2) Credits & discounts: we will apply a one-time $5k onboarding credit to your first invoice. If you commit to $100k ARR in an order form, we will apply a 10% first-year discount (details to be written in the SOW/order form).
3) Minimums: our standard protective clause — a $10k monthly minimum during the first 90 days of invoicing — will be included in the order form. This is negotiable for strategic accounts but helps us manage cost during pilot-to-production transitions.
4) Migration: if you start on card and later provide a PO, we can migrate billing and backdate consolidation to the start of that month (subject to billing cycle timing).

Next steps I recommend:
- Morgan: share the PO once available to ap@redwood.ai.
- PilotRetail Finance: send any vendor registration or tax forms you need; Ben/RevOps will review.
- I will route an order form (including the credit and discount language) to your legal and finance contacts and include a DocuSign link for signature.

Attachment: Redwood_ratecard_v2.pdf (PDF, 240KB)
Related link: https://docusign.com/Envelope/XYZ-12345 (MSA + order form)

Happy to hop on a 15 minute call if you want to walk through the flow with your AP team.

Best,
